heading: Federal funding prohibited
lead: The Association may not receive, accept, or borrow any amounts from the Federal Government to pay for, or reimburse,1 the Association for, the costs of establishing or operating the Association.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 6763, Pub. L. 106–102, title III, § 333, Nov. 12, 1999, 113 Stat. 1432, related to relationship to State law, prior to the general amendment of this subchapter by Pub. L. 114–1. See section 6760 of this title.

sourceCredit: (Pub. L. 106–102, title III, § 333, as added Pub. L. 114–1, title II, § 202(a), Jan. 12, 2015, 129 Stat. 27.)
